plan.line: a slide switch (on/off) that stays where the user slides it. Use it for something that is either on or off, or for choosing between two modes; use a push button for presses.

code.pinLine: slide switch {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP). value() is 0 while it is slid to its ground side (call that ON) and 1 on the other side (OFF). It stays where the user leaves it: read its position each time round the loop, don't wait for presses.
handoff: | {gpio} | {phys} | {refs} | {mode} | `Pin({g}, Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)  (0 = slid to the ground side)` |
code.ragQuery: GPIO digital input with pull-up resistor
